# AWS App Runner

Store App Runner services, revisioned configurations, connections and VPC connectors as metadata over AWS JSON 1.0.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `apprunner` |
| Signing name | `apprunner` |
| Wire protocol | AWS JSON 1.0 |
| API version | `2020-05-15` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Records only |
| Selected operations | 28 of 37 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#aws-app-runner) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- No container runtime, builds, repository clone/authentication, source polling, automatic deployments, traffic, DNS, health checks, metrics, tracing, IAM role use, KMS encryption or network provisioning. Source, instance, encryption, network, observability and health-check settings are records only.
- ServiceUrl is a deterministic placeholder host derived from the stored service ID and Region; it is not served and has no traffic.
- No custom domains or VPC ingress connections. ListServicesForAutoScalingConfiguration is not implemented.
- Deleted service records and inactive configuration revisions are retained indefinitely; no AWS cleanup delay is emulated. Latest refers to the highest stored revision, including retained tombstones, while partial ARNs select active revisions.
- App Runner referenced network and observability settings are stored without provisioning or cross-service validation; no AWS quotas or external provider handshakes are simulated.
- CloudFormation service optional-property removal is rejected when the API cannot clear it. Service tag changes are applied in place.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
